Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 23.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 25 to 26 Holy damage to an enemy.
